item.title: Acme Finance exploited for $2.5 million
item.dc:creator: Jane Reporter
item.description: Investigator @ExampleSleuth said the attacker abused the DeFi protocol's withdrawFunds() function and sent funds to 0x1111111111111111111111111111111111111111. CEO Jane Example said users would be repaid.

item.title: Acme Finance suspect John Doe arrested, police say
item.description: Police arrested John Doe, 31, in connection with the Acme Finance crypto hack, according to a statement. He has not been charged.

item.title: Acme Token price surges 40% after the hack
item.description: The token price rallied as traders bought the dip; analysts are bullish.
